mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances that may impair melatonin metabolism and increase oxidative stress, while melatonin's antioxidant properties may theoretically modulate amphotericin B's fungicidal effects.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; melatonin may be used as adjunctive antioxidant support but should not replace standard nephroprotective measures; coordinate timing to minimize competing metabolic demands.
